title: Kill all with custom text
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players") -- fuck xeno users not having cloneref :broken_heart:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local AttackRemote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Events"):WaitForChild("MeleeAttack")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

getgenv().rapeall = true
getgenv().CustomText = "Silly catbois :3"

while true do
    if getgenv().rapeall then
        for i, v in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if v ~= LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.Character ~= nil and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") ~= nil and v.Character ~= nil and v.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") ~= nil then
                local args = {
                    [1] = {
                        ["rayInstance"] = v.Character.HumanoidRootPart,
                        ["rayPosition"] = v.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position,
                        ["rayMaterial"] = Enum.Material.Fabric,
                        ["rayNormal"] = Vector3.new(0.5008270740509033, 0.04255622625350952, -0.8645005822181702)
                    },
                    [2] = LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart,
                    [3] = Vector3.new(),
                    [4] = 8,
                    [5] = {
                        ["MainDamage"] = math.huge,
                        ["BackstabDamage"] = math.huge,
                        ["AltDamage"] = math.huge
                    },
                    [6] = 2,
                    [7] = false,
                    [8] = getgenv().CustomText
                }

                AttackRemote:FireServer(unpack(args))
            end
            task.wait()
        end
    else
        break
    end
end
features: Just a simple kill all with fe custom kill text
